verdict.rationale: Runpod's Pod docs mention a web proxy for exposed web services, which covers serving applications from an instance. Instance-to-instance connectivity is evidenced only through Instant Clusters' "high-performance networking" for multi-node workloads, not an explicit private network between ordinary Pods. Community remarks that the environment is "locked down" are hedged speculation rather than a concrete failure, so they lower confidence but do not create a dispute. missing for 10: explicit port-configuration docs (HTTP/TCP port mapping), documented private networking between standalone Pods, hands-on corroboration of exposed services.
